title: Rawdat al-Nazir wa Junnat al-Munazir
author: ibn-qudama
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Ibn Qudama's handbook of Hanbali legal theory, closely following the order of al-Ghazali's al-Mustasfa while adjusting it to Hanbali positions. It became the standard usul text of the school.
historicalContext: The work shows how the Hanbalis adopted the theologians' framework for legal theory while keeping their own positions on revelation and analogy; al-Tufi's later abridgement and commentary were built on it.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
